teaching_description: A collaborative English learning platform for students, independent learners, and educators. Structured lessons, learning resources, and interactive tools support vocabulary, grammar, and comprehension. A clean interface and modular components bring external resources, Google documents, and shared content into one study environment.
teaching_overview: The English Teaching Platform is a collaborative project that organizes English learning and teaching resources in a structured online environment. It integrates learning tools and educational materials for students, independent learners, and educators.
teaching_lessons: Centralized materials including structured lessons, grammar references, and vocabulary resources.
teaching_shared_resources: Integrated Google documents and shared resources for collaborative content development.
teaching_interface: A clean interface designed for accessibility, readability, and organized study workflows.
teaching_modular: Modular front-end components that support future quizzes, exercises, and interactive lessons.
teaching_usability: The system emphasizes simplicity and usability so learners can quickly find educational resources. Curated notes, collaborative content, and external tools create a centralized study environment for English education.
teaching_collaboration: Developed with contributors from the development team, the project focuses on organizing language resources and building an extensible foundation for lesson tracking, exercises, and interactive teaching tools.
teaching_demo_description: This preview demonstrates the English Teaching Platform, including its key features, interface design, navigation, and example user workflows.
teaching_demo_hint: Watch the clip for a quick overview of the main features and visual design.
teaching_materials_description: Explore my teaching philosophy, curriculum design ideas, and structured English teaching materials. The embedded document stays up to date as I revise it.
